import pandas as pd

# Load the metric files
node_metrics = pd.read_parquet('/telemetry/row/metric/metric_node.parquet')
container_metrics = pd.read_parquet('/telemetry/row/metric/metric_container.parquet')
service_metrics = pd.read_parquet('/telemetry/row/metric/metric_service.parquet')
middleware_metrics = pd.read_parquet('/telemetry/row/metric/metric_middleware.parquet')
app_metrics = pd.read_parquet('/telemetry/row/metric/metric_app.parquet')

# Combine all metrics into a single DataFrame
all_metrics = pd.concat([node_metrics, container_metrics, service_metrics, middleware_metrics, app_metrics], ignore_index=True)

# Convert the timestamp to datetime
all_metrics['timestamp'] = pd.to_datetime(all_metrics['timestamp'], utc=True)

# Load the global KPI thresholds
metric_stats = pd.read_parquet('/telemetry/metric_stats.parquet')

# Perform anomaly detection by comparing metrics against thresholds
anomalies = []
for index, row in metric_stats.iterrows():
    metric_name = row['metric']
    threshold_mean = row['mean']
    threshold_std = row['std']
    metric_data = all_metrics[all_metrics['name'] == metric_name]
    if not metric_data.empty:
        for _, metric_row in metric_data.iterrows():
            if abs(metric_row['value'] - threshold_mean) > 2 * threshold_std:
                anomalies.append({
                    'timestamp': metric_row['timestamp'],
                    'metric': metric_name,
                    'value': metric_row['value'],
                    'threshold_mean': threshold_mean,
                    'threshold_std': threshold_std
                })

# Return the anomalies detected
anomalies

exceeding_components
